boot_handoff_complete.assessment: Sampled trained FSBL terminal and OCM observer passed in candidate boot; no independent persistent boot identity.

no_handler_active.assessment: Core-loop boundary entry and coherent publication observed; asynchronous exception/ROM paths remain unexcluded.

scheduler_stopped.assessment: Normal linked guard path never returns to scheduler; physical record proves entry, not all future control flow.

interrupt_delivery_excluded.assessment: MSR IE cleared with other bits preserved in four records; EE remains enabled, not all exception/reset sources excluded.

other_core_release_excluded.assessment: Prior APU reset/RPU samples are necessary observations, not prevention of later release.

pmu_memory_access_excluded.assessment: Normal terminal uses local instruction sleep/reentry; exception/MMIO/ROM transitive paths not closed.

history_drained.assessment: No-master PL suppresses new requests; prior accepted PS transactions and reset epochs not fully qualified.
